question.problem: Consider the matrix given by $M=[\begin{aligned}3 & -3 \\ 1 & -2 \\ 6 & 3\end{aligned}].$ Determine the value of $k$ for which the vector $b=[\begin{aligned}4 \\ 0 \\ 2k+10\end{aligned}]$ belongs to $\text{Col}(M).$
question.worked_solution:
If $b$ lies in $\text{Col}(M),$ then the equation $Mx=b$ must be consistent. So, let's find the row echelon form of the augmented matrix $[M\,|\,b]$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}[M\,|\,b] & =[\begin{aligned}3 & -3 & 4 \\ 1 & -2 & 0 \\ 6 & 3 & 2k+10\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & ↔{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 0 \\ 3 & -3 & 4 \\ 6 & 3 & 2k+10\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+(-3){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 0 \\ 0 & 3 & 4 \\ 6 & 3 & 2k+10\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-6){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 0 \\ 0 & 3 & 4 \\ 0 & 15 & 2k+10\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-5){R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 0 \\ 0 & 3 & 4 \\ 0 & 0 & 2k-10\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

So, we have the system

$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-2{x}_{2}=0 \\ 3{x}_{2}=4 \\ 0=2k-10.\end{aligned}
$$

In order for this system to be consistent, we require $0=2k-10,$ which means that $k=5.$
